hero.lead: Camshaft failure is often caused by oil starvation. A worn cam lobe destroys the valve train. On interference engines, incorrect valve timing from a failed cam lobe can cause pistons to hit valves — turning a £400-£1,800 repair into a £2,500-£6,500 engine replacement. Regular oil changes are cheap insurance.

blocks.question: What are the early symptoms of camshaft failure? +
blocks.answer: Tapping/ticking noise from top of engine, rough idle, loss of power, engine management light with cam/crank correlation codes (P0016-P0019), constant misfire, metal debris in oil.

blocks.question: How much does a camshaft replacement cost in the UK? +
blocks.answer: Single cam (SOHC or one DOHC cam): £400-£900. Both cams (DOHC): £800-£1,800. Cam journal polishing: £65-£105. Complete cylinder head replacement: £1,000-£3,000+. Engine replacement: £2,500-£6,500+. Labour: 4-10 hours at £65-£95/hr indie. Engine repair cost guide

blocks.question: Can I still drive with a camshaft problem? +
blocks.answer: If you have a tapping noise but no misfire, you can drive to a garage for diagnostic. If you have a misfire or cam/crank correlation codes (P0016-P0019), stop driving - especially on interference engines. Ignoring cam timing faults risks valve/piston contact and complete engine destruction.

blocks.question: Which engines are most prone to camshaft failure? +
blocks.answer: Based on Engines Market enquiry volumes, BMW N47D20C (1,450 requests), Mercedes OM651 (1,250), VW/Audi EA189 (1,050), and Land Rover 204DTD (1,150) are among the most frequently requested diesel engines. Camshaft wear is one of several valve train faults specialists may investigate. Regular oil changes with correct spec oil are critical. [EM-VERIFIED]

blocks.question: How can I prevent camshaft failure? +
blocks.answer: The single biggest cause of camshaft failure is oil starvation from sludge. Change the oil every 8,000-10,000 miles with manufacturer-approved spec. That £100 oil change is cheap insurance against a £1,500 camshaft repair.

blocks.question: Is it better to repair or replace the engine? +
blocks.answer: Under £2,000 car value - If camshaft failed, consider scrap or used cylinder head. £2,000-£4,000 - Single cam replacement (£400-£900) viable. £4,000-£8,000 - Cam replacement or used cylinder head justified. £8,000+ - Any repair - even full cylinder head or reconditioned replacement.
